summary: Completed backend + frontend regression for release sorting, payment income summary, and withdraw cashflow/list period filtering on public preview URL. Backend targeted suite and frontend production build passed; UI finance flows validated on desktop/mobile with expected month-switch behavior.
action_items: Optional: add deterministic loading/refresh indicator on Withdraw list after status filter change to reduce short-wait automation flakiness.
If release ordering must be visually re-verified in UI list (not just API), ensure preview has at least one seeded release dataset visible to admin pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Release ordering implementation in /api/admin/releases aligns with required status priority and keeps unknown status last; same-status recency is preserved via stable two-pass sort using submitted_at/updated_at/created_at fallback.
Finance summary aggregation in /api/admin/payments/summary correctly scopes to status=paid and paid_at with payments.amount; invalid year/month constraints are enforced via FastAPI Query validation.
Withdraw summary/list logic correctly separates pending (requested+approved by request_date) and outgoing (paid by paid_date), and enforces year/month pair validation for period filtering.
Recent backend startup logs show no index conflict or bootstrap exceptions; tested response payloads did not expose Mongo _id/ObjectId in checked endpoints.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (finance/release UI checks passed on desktop/mobile; release list had no rows in current preview dataset)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST data in Mongo (iter53 prefixes) inside pytest and cleaned it in finally blocks; no persistent fixture mutation left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x800 checks passed for payments/withdraw overview cards, selectors, 12-month grid, and overflow. Payments defaulted to Jakarta current period (Sep 2026) showing Rp150.000 and changed to Aug Rp70.000. Withdraw default Sep showed outgoing Rp40.000/pending Rp50.000 and changed to Aug outgoing Rp60.000/pending Rp0.
